Name: Gallery (of Doors)
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300491-1066288686.png[/img][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]A gallery-styled farm building with vanilla seasonal sprites and a small footprint, designed for use as a hub for PIF doors. Also perfectly functional as a standalone building to display amassed trophies / artwork. Build settings are fully customisable.[/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Despite being a farm building, this mod is not included in  [b]More Building Options[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34977]Pack 1[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34981]Pack 2[/url] at time of publishing.[/size][/color]

[center][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300490-1536689588.png[/img][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] (Optional)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300497-1310446398.png[/img][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][size=3]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Gallery of Doors[/b] to your mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file and install as usual.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=3][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300494-427719187.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]Building Enabled[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]True[/i]: Mod enabled[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]False[/i]: Mod disabled (Do not disable after building!)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Building Version[/b][/color]
[i]Gallery[/i]: Building is called the Gallery
[i]Gallery of Doors[/i]: Building is called the Gallery of Doors (PIF theming)

[b]Building Cost[/b]
[i]Standard[/i]: 7,950g, 160 Wood
[color=#d4d4d8][i]Free[/i]: 0g[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]Gold Only[/i]: 9,550g[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]Gold Only, Cheap[/i]: 500g[/color]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]Build Time[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]Standard[/i]: Two days to build[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]Instant[/i]: Instant build[/color]

[center][size=3][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300494-596560404.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]No compatibility issues noted.[/size]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300587-1058113607.png[/img][/size][/color][/center]

[size=3]Concept suggested by DaezeeChayne on [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1484]Github[/url].[/size]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52846/52846-1790300498-1623793061.png[/img][/size][/color][/center]

Manifest.Name: Gallery (of Doors) - A PIF Building
Manifest.Description: A simple, small footprint Gallery building for putting up your paints, which optionally changes from 'Gallery' to 'Gallery of Doors' if you have PIF installed.
Manifest.Author: ASLaneZero
